title: ztest: migrate regional_duty_cycle
description:
Migrate lichen/tests/regional_duty_cycle/ from manual main() to ztest macros.

## Steps
1. Replace `#include <stdio.h>` etc with `#include <zephyr/ztest.h>`
2. Convert `static int test_foo(void) { ... return failed; }` to `ZTEST(suite, test_foo) { ... zassert_*(...); }`
3. Delete main() and add `ZTEST_SUITE(regional_duty_cycle, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL);`
4. Build: west build -b native_sim lichen/tests/regional_duty_cycle
5. Run: west build -t run

## Reference
See lichen/tests/util/main.c for ztest pattern.
